test_cases.description: Each route entry's path must correspond to the correct PageComponentKey — an implementation could have all 13 correct paths and all 13 correct keys but pair them incorrectly
test_cases.expected_output_description: Every entry's path and componentKey are correctly paired per the canonical mapping
assertions: Each componentKey is paired with its canonical path

test_cases.description: The route manifest must be immutable at runtime — mutations to the returned array or its entries should not affect subsequent calls or the source data
assertions: Mutating the returned array does not change subsequent getRouteManifest results
Object.isFrozen or readonly semantics prevent modification

test_cases.description: Route labels must be non-trivial human-readable strings (not just whitespace or single characters), verifying they are genuine navigation labels rather than placeholder stubs
The Home entry must use exactly '/' as its path — not '/home' or any other variant — and must be at index 0
assertions: Entry at index 0 has componentKey Home

test_cases.description: Steps must appear in strict numeric order 0,1a,1b,2a,2b,3,4,5a,5b,5c,6,7 after Home — verifying sub-step ordering within the same number
RouteEntry objects should contain only the three specified fields (path, label, componentKey) — no extraneous properties that could indicate a non-conformant implementation
assertions: Each entry has exactly 3 own enumerable keys

test_cases.description: Although the contract doesn't explicitly require unique labels, having duplicate labels would indicate a degenerate implementation that hardcoded the same placeholder label for all entries
assertions: All 13 labels are distinct from each other

test_cases.description: App.tsx must provide both a named export 'App' and a default export, and they must reference the same component
assertions: Named and default exports are the same reference

test_cases.description: The App component must pass the complete ROUTE_MANIFEST as the routes prop to PageLayout — not a subset, transformation, or empty array
Each manifest path must render a distinct component — an implementation could pass visible tests by rendering the same stub component for every route
assertions: Navigating to different paths renders different page components

test_cases.description: Middle-of-manifest routes (not just '/' or the last entry) must render correctly — catches implementations that only handle the first and last routes
Every value in the PAGE_COMPONENTS map must be a distinct component reference — not the same component reused for all keys
assertions: All 13 component values are distinct references

test_cases.description: Each componentKey value must be an exact member of the PageComponentKey enum — not a lookalike string, not differing in case
assertions: componentKey values are strictly equal to enum members, not just similar strings

test_cases.description: Navigating to a path that is a sub-path of a valid route (e.g., '/step-0-cartographer/extra') should not match the parent route — catches overly permissive route matching
assertions: Sub-path of a valid route does not render the parent route's component

test_cases.description: getRouteManifest should return the same constant reference on repeated calls — it is a module-level constant, not a factory
assertions: Two successive calls return the same array reference
